name: ana-tilim
description: Independent Uyghur language learning portfolio project with human audio, bilingual UI, guest progress, and optional cloud sync. Source-visible, not open source.

paragraphs: A mobile-first Uyghur language learning experience with human audio, guided practice, offline progress, and optional cloud sync.

features: Uyghur alphabet forms, joining behavior, pronunciation guidance, and ULY
Vocabulary, combinations, reading material, grammar examples, proverbs,
Bundled human-recorded audio for letters, vocabulary, examples, and reading
Listening, dictation, matching, review, and learning-progress activities

requirements.text: sign-in 游客可本地学习；Google 登录后可进行按用户 UID 隔离的云同步
Guests can use local learning features without signing in; Google sign-in and UID-scoped cloud synchronization require an internet connection.
